words.sense: A category of art, writing, or music identified by shared subject, form, or conventions.
misconceptions: An unusual voice does not alone establish a category.

words.sense: The distinctive manner in which something is expressed or made.
misconceptions: A subject-based category is not one creator’s manner.

semantic_axes.description: Category based on common conventions versus characteristic mode of expression.

edges.boundary_rule: Genre identifies the kind of creative work; style identifies how the work is expressed.

misconceptions.M1: Confuses shared conventions of a creative category with an artist’s personal manner.
misconceptions.M2: Treats distinctive delivery or brushwork as a category of work.
misconceptions.M3: Lets an irrelevant feature such as length or popularity decide the choice.

chains.frame: Which word best describes the grouping on Lila’s reading list?

beats.text: Lila puts together novels built around a puzzling crime, scattered clues, and a final solution.
beats.decisive_clue: works share a recognizable mystery plot structure
beats.reason: The first detail establishes works share a recognizable mystery plot structure; that is the meaningful distinction.

beats.text: Some are written in short chapters and others in long ones, but all use the same kind of plot.
beats.decisive_clue: different sentence lengths do not undo the shared category
beats.reason: The new detail confirms different sentence lengths do not undo the shared category and rules out the competing sense.

chains.feedback_short: Shared plot conventions define the grouping despite different writing methods.
chains.feedback_deep: Genre means a category of creative work. Style means a characteristic manner of expression. Here, the selection follows narrative conventions rather than one author’s prose habits.
chains.contrast_rule: Genre asks what kind; style asks how it is expressed.

hints.attention: What do all the books have in common?
hints.axis: Category based on common conventions versus characteristic mode of expression.
hints.contrast: Genre asks what kind; style asks how it is expressed.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Tariq’s way of singing?

beats.text: Tariq stretches the last syllable of each line and sings the next one in a hushed voice.
beats.decisive_clue: a personal manner of vocal delivery
beats.reason: The first detail establishes a personal manner of vocal delivery; that is the meaningful distinction.

beats.text: He uses the same delivery for a lullaby and a fast dance song.
beats.decisive_clue: his delivery remains recognizable across different song types
beats.reason: The deciding fact remains a personal manner of vocal delivery; the added detail does not change that.

chains.feedback_short: The characteristic delivery survives a change in song type.
chains.feedback_deep: Genre means a category of creative work. Style means a characteristic manner of expression. Here, changing the kind of music does not turn a singing manner into a class of music.
chains.contrast_rule: Genre asks what kind; style asks how it is expressed.

hints.attention: Listen to how he sings, not which songs he chooses.
hints.axis: Category based on common conventions versus characteristic mode of expression.
hints.contrast: Genre asks what kind; style asks how it is expressed.

beats.text: Sora writes in tiny sentences, then ends every paragraph with a surprising, longer line.

beats.reason: The first detail establishes a recurring pattern of sentence construction; that is the meaningful distinction.

beats.text: Her essay is about local bus routes, but the same sentence pattern appears in her travel journal.

beats.reason: The new detail confirms the same verbal manner appears across different subjects and rules out the competing sense.

chains.feedback_short: The pattern of sentences, not the subject, is what repeats.
chains.feedback_deep: Genre means a category of creative work. Style means a characteristic manner of expression. Here, sentence rhythm is the distinctive feature even when subject matter changes.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Hugo’s selection of stories?

beats.text: Hugo groups stories in which ordinary life is interrupted by mysterious events that have no natural explanation.
beats.decisive_clue: shared supernatural story conventions define the grouping
beats.reason: The first detail establishes shared supernatural story conventions define the grouping; that is the meaningful distinction.

beats.text: He discovers the stories come from five countries and were written decades apart.
beats.decisive_clue: the common story pattern remains across different origins
beats.reason: Viewed in its fuller context, the common story pattern remains across different origins; the original distinction still decides it.

chains.feedback_short: The stories share a recognizable kind despite differing origins.
chains.feedback_deep: Genre means a category of creative work. Style means a characteristic manner of expression. Here, the grouping is based on what sort of stories they are, not on their place or date of origin.
chains.contrast_rule: Genre asks what kind; style asks how it is expressed.

hints.axis: Category based on common conventions versus characteristic mode of expression.
hints.contrast: Genre asks what kind; style asks how it is expressed.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Mina’s approach to painting her mural?

beats.text: Mina paints with repeated sharp triangles and thin silver lines, even when drawing curved objects.
beats.decisive_clue: a consistent individual way of making marks
beats.reason: The first detail establishes a consistent individual way of making marks; that is the meaningful distinction.

beats.text: The mural is large enough to cover a wall, but its distinctive marks remain the same.
beats.decisive_clue: scale does not alter the characteristic painting manner
beats.reason: The deciding fact remains a consistent individual way of making marks; the added detail does not change that.

chains.feedback_short: The visual manner matters; the wall’s size does not.
chains.feedback_deep: Genre means a category of creative work. Style means a characteristic manner of expression. Here, size affects the work’s dimensions, not the expressive approach that identifies its maker.
chains.contrast_rule: Genre asks what kind; style asks how it is expressed.

hints.attention: Notice the repeated marks rather than the mural’s dimensions.

hints.contrast: Genre asks what kind; style asks how it is expressed.
